description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LeaveEntitlementDaoTest' for testing the 'LeaveEntitlementDao' class related to leave entitlement data access in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, various test cases for querying, saving, deleting, and verifying leave entitlement data, using mock data and dependencies.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to test the data access object (DAO) for leave entitlements, covering functionalities like search, save, delete, and retrieve leave entitlement data, including edge cases and data integrity checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO instance, loads test fixtures, and prepares mock services for each test.

methods.name: _compareEntitlements
methods.description: Helper method to compare two lists of LeaveEntitlement objects for equality.

methods.name: _compareEntitlement
methods.description: Helper method to compare two LeaveEntitlement objects for equality.

methods.name: _verifyDeletedFlags
methods.description: Verifies the deletion flags of entitlements by checking expected IDs.
